URL: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c304l24m0leo
NOTE: BBC News (18 Jul 2026) — Badenoch brands Burnham a "people pleaser" with "airy fairy" plans; won't give a "blank cheque". Verbatim quotes.
Badenoch (to BBC's Laura Kuenssberg): "I will score as many points as possible if it means the right thing for the country. What I'm not going to do is give Andy Burnham a blank cheque." Called Burnham a "nice guy" and "people pleaser" but: "The job is not a popularity contest... he has not said what he's going to do. It's all airy-fairy stuff." Said he was "a man who was talking to the Labour Party, not to the country." In a letter to Burnham she offered to work on cutting the welfare bill but urged him to "rule out any new tax rises now" and warned she would "never shirk" from holding him to account. Burnham's first PMQs falls Wednesday.
